liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cosmic Charlie** (2 reviews): Show is noteworthy because it holds the final performance of this song; Noted as the last time the band played Cosmic Charlie [6][15]
- **Mama Tried** (1 review): Even a basic tune like Mama Tried is played with gusto in the first set [17]
- **It's All Over Now** (1 other source): This song was left off the Dick's Picks 20 release [5]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Garcia explores the Let It Grow jam extensively, to the point of meltdown [17]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Sugaree is very powerful within an otherwise mellow show [7]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): The Lazy Lightning into Supplication pairing is singled out as worth hearing on its own [14]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this Half-Step among the best versions around [7]
- **Dancing In The Street** (1 review): Reviewer, usually lukewarm on this song, finds the version flowing into Cosmic Charlie about as good as it gets [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **It's All Over Now**: back after 358 archived shows (2136 days) [18]
- **St. Stephen Reprise**: rare: 3 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-09-25.148827.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 178 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1976-09-25.147662.aud.jones.flac1644**: audience recording; 22 songs; 175 min [3]
- **gd76-09-25.sbd.aj.246.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 165 min; rated 3.83/5 by 12 [4]. Said about its sound: Stays crisp even when played at very high volume; Reviewer describes the sound quality as great; Known flaws: one second of distortion on disc three, and Sunshine Daydream cuts in at 0:27 [4][7][14]
- **gd1976-09-25.sbd.vernon.10511.shnf**: soundboard; 1 songs; 8 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first Dead show, at age sixteen; the band played a couple of warm-up tunes [8]
- Reviewer's first bootleg tape; they shared Sugaree and Peggy-O from it with their mother, who still loves them [15]
- Capital Centre is also home of the Washington Capitals, a large hockey arena [17]
- Lee Maddex took photos at the show [3]
- Reviewer prefers the 28th to this show and also recommends checking out the 27th [6]
- Reviewer considers it one of the best shows of 1976, with Garcia playing flawlessly [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-09-25.148827.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Kathy Sublette's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158 [1]
- **gd1976-09-25.147662.aud.jones.flac1644**: taped by Scott Jones via Lee Maddex; transferred by Andrew F. and Joe B. Jones; source: Presumed source: Shure SM-57's > Sony TC-158SD, concert recording by Scott Jones, MAC > C > C (2nd Gen, c.1978) cassettes via Lee Maddex. [3]. Also: Audience source from Lee Maddex's cassettes, with an initial 2007 transfer by Joe B. Jones; lineage is best recollection [3]
- **gd76-09-25.sbd.aj.246.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Soundboard master to cassette, DAT, CD, EAC, then SHN, circulated via A. Jerugim [4]
- **gd1976-09-25.sbd.vernon.10511.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Soundboard leftovers from Dick's Picks 20 containing It's All Over Now, transferred via Matt Vernon [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by getwallpapers.com: [HD Grateful Dead Wallpaper (65+ images)](https://getwallpapers.com/collection/hd-grateful-dead-wallpaper) [19]
